bio: Adjunct Professor of Epidemiology Epidemiology, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Epidemiology I am Professor of Epidemiology with primary appointment in the Department of Epidemiology and an affiliated appointment in the Department of Immunology and Infectious Diseases, where my wet lab is located. I direct the Center for Communicable Disease Dynamics, a center of excellence funded by the MIDAS program of NIH/NIGMS. I am also the Associate Director of the Interdisciplinary Concentration in Infectious Disease Epidemiology. B.A., Philosophy Yale University
